name: trackmania-livery-studio
description: Experimental AI-assisted Trackmania Stadium skin workflow with editable sources and DDS export.

interface.shortDescription: AI-assisted Stadium skins and verified DDS export.
interface.longDescription: An experimental, AI-created community workflow for Trackmania 2020 Stadium. Creates editable artwork, projects it onto audited UVs and builds DDS skin ZIPs. Windows desktop execution is required for the bundled encoder. Not affiliated with Nadeo or Ubisoft; not listed in the official OpenAI directory.
defaultPrompt: Сделай импортируемый скин Trackmania 2020 по моей идее.

publication.release_notes: Initial public alpha. AI-created project shared by meowflyx because it may be useful to others. Local/export and external-preview validation are distinct from in-game validation.
